name: Spamhaus Data Query Service (DQS: zen/dbl.dq.spamhaus.net)
tier_rationale: Spamhaus is named trusted by A8 BR2 (established security organisation with published terms); DQS is its keyed DNS service.

reliability.justification: Curated reputation zones (SBL, CSS, XBL, PBL, DBL) maintained by Spamhaus researchers; very low false-positive rate.

spamhaus_dqs.description: Spamhaus Data Query Service (DQS) key: embedded in the DNS query name, so it is only ever sent through the system resolver (never public DoH)
spamhaus_dqs.plan_hint: free DQS accounts are non-commercial; record 'business' only for a commercial DQS subscription (key_plans.spamhaus_dqs)

zen.title: Spamhaus ZEN through DQS (<reversed ip>.<key>.zen.dq.spamhaus.net, DNS A)

terms.quote: P045 cond 1 (binding council text): Spamhaus ZEN/DBL only through a DQS key on the plan legal decides (key-terms; commercial DQS for business use; key_plans.spamhaus_dqs); public Spamhaus mirrors are noncommercial and never used.

zen.notes: Quote: binding council text (P045 cond 1). The free DQS account is non-commercial (the public mirror's fair-use policy reads 'The DNSBL Public Mirror is provided free of charge for non-commercial use by small and medium sized organisations', https://www.spamhaus.org/blocklists/dnsbl-fair-use-policy/): under the corporate profile it runs only with key_plans.spamhaus_dqs = business (a commercial DQS subscription). The key sits in the query name: system resolver through dnspython only, never public DoH, query name redacted (P045 cond 3). Used by dnsbl.
zen.licensed_alternative: A commercial Spamhaus DQS subscription recorded as key_plans.spamhaus_dqs = business.

dbl.title: Spamhaus DBL through DQS (<domain>.<key>.dbl.dq.spamhaus.net, DNS A)

terms.quote: P045 cond 1 (binding council text): Spamhaus ZEN/DBL only through a DQS key on the plan legal decides (key-terms; commercial DQS for business use; key_plans.spamhaus_dqs); public Spamhaus mirrors are noncommercial and never used.

dbl.notes: Quote: binding council text (P045 cond 1). Domain zone: domains only (P045 cond 9). Same key, plan and resolver rules as the ZEN source. Used by dnsbl.
dbl.licensed_alternative: A commercial Spamhaus DQS subscription recorded as key_plans.spamhaus_dqs = business.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G02-2 (P045). A provider of its own because the DQS key and the keyed zones belong together (the licence gate reads the plan of a key of the source's own provider); the 'spamhaus' fragment (DROP lists over HTTP) is owned by batch p1-G02-2 and untouched. The public mirrors zen.spamhaus.org / dbl.spamhaus.org are noncommercial and never used (P045 cond 1). DNS only: the list is queried through DNS A lookups (core DoH layer or the system resolver), never over HTTP, so the provider has no HTTP host. Every DNSBL counts as ONE 'spam' family vote in P171 consensus (upstream_family 'dnsbl', P045 cond 8).
